status: Constructive finite candidate, not closure or permission gate; final exact consumer binding in interface and synthesis
primitive_inputs: Four scalar-colour CAR creators per site in one Fock space
Right colour Gauss projection and left frame derivatives
Two source-family internal mirror labels, centre sewing, charge, geometry and coupling strengths
Finite field coordinate regulator and specified longitudinal Gaussian charge-cloud kernel
raw_frame: G_a=R_a+C_a; P_G spans ker(sum G_a²). d_alpha=P_G†[D^(1/2)(frame) epsilon c†]_alpha P_G. S_a=P_G†L_aP_G. No free physical gamma/spin matrix is inserted. The entire 16-state physical local N0..4 space, with j=0,1/2,1 components, is retained.
ordered_path: For an oriented curve r, omega_s=(r_s-a e_x/2) cross Delta r_s / a²; R_r=ordered product exp(-i theta omega_s dot S). The reflected reverse curve rbar_s=a e_x-r_(end-s) has omega_bar=-omega reversed, hence R_rbar=R_r† exactly at the finite path regulator.
vector: b_(r,alpha)=R_r d_alpha† R_r† - R_r† d_alpha† R_r. Scalar-family projector Pi_+ selects alpha0,1 on r; Pi_- selects alpha2,3 on rbar. B_r is its actual source-adjoint representation, B_rbar=-B_r. Retaining the two different internal channels gives V=diag(D,-D), not D+(-D)=0. D†=-D. No Clifford matrix is imported; any transfer anticommutator is measured on the actual R-derived matrix.
scalar: M exchanges the two scalar source families and commutes physical S. The straight actual spatial route carries h_scalar d_i† M d_(i+1)+h.c. Its geometric route amplitude is an input, not a new onsite mass constant. {M,V}=0 follows from same-channel-identical frame action and opposite channel grading; finite consumer measures it.
parity: P reflects site i to -i, swaps the two internal source families and sends both physical polar field Q_a to -Q_a. Actual path r maps to reflected reverse rbar. P transfers each forward route to its partner adjoint; P H P†=H, P S P†=S, P physicalJ P†=-physicalJ, P V_CM P†=-V_CM. These identities are checked rather than enforced by averaging the vector transfer.
exact_common_q_geometry: Finite T3: q=(2pi/a,0,0), n_1=e_y,n_2=e_z. A_1(r)=(n_1 cross qhat) cos(q dot r)=-e_z cos(kx); A_2(r)=e_y cos(kx). Both are exact orthogonal transverse directions at the SAME +q and -q, not two A_x envelopes. Their actual line phases ell_(r,a)=sum_s A_a(mid_s) dot Delta r_s use the same noncoplanar routes. M_ab=epsilon integral_T3 A_a dot A_b=epsilon L_x L_y L_z delta_ab/2. No bare magnetic energy or oscillator restoring potential is supplied.
Hamiltonian: H=frame_cost sum_i S_i² + 1/2 sum_ij rho_i K_ij rho_j + 1/2 P_field^T M^-1 P_field + sum_routes [F_r exp(-i charge ell_r dot Q)+h.c.]; rho_i=charge(N_i-2). The coordinate regulator uses Dirichlet second difference for diagonal electric kinetic and first-difference momenta for field-only unitary kicks. F_r includes full CAR strings. The finite longitudinal minimum-image K is specified, not asserted to be the exact torus Maxwell Green function.
physical_current: J_a=-partial H/partial externalA_a=charge sum_r ell_(r,a) i(link_r-link_r†); K_ab=partial²H/(partial externalA_a partial externalA_b)=-charge² sum_r ell_(r,a)ell_(r,b)(link_r+link_r†). CM V=a sum edge i(link-link†). Local number continuity is independently measured.
occupied_sources: Reference is the entire degenerate lowest eigenprojector of actual N=2L occupied H over every lattice momentum. Addition and removal both use this SAME reference. G_ab(z,k)=sum_n <Omega|d_a|n+><n+|d_b†|Omega>/(z-(E_n+-E_Omega)) + sum_n <Omega|d_b†|n-><n-|d_a|Omega>/(z+(E_n--E_Omega)). All complete N=2L+-1 spectra and CAR sums are retained; no second antiparticle copy is introduced.
rest_adverse: For every source-bright energy-degenerate block W, report W†V_CM W and W†J_a W as full matrices/eigenvalues, all residues, S² and all lower branches. A zero diagonal expectation or opposite-velocity average is not rest. No dominant excited residue, sector floor, fixed-spin projection, finite-flux curvature or dark lower state is promoted to electron inertia.
field_legs: Own positive-frequency normalized global field-insertion legs are constructed from Q_1+iQ_2 and Q_1-0.61iQ_2 acting on an actual charged reference, excluding its degenerate zero gap and all negative-energy differences. Energy is the spectral residue-weighted gap of this same H. These global broad legs are not a field-only injected photon or asymptotic S state.
virtual_interaction: R=K_out,in|g> + J_out(E_g+omega_in+i eta-H)^-1J_in|g> + J_in(E_g-omega_out+i eta-H)^-1J_out|g>. All complete charged virtual states, both time orders and same-current contact retained. Sum of every final |<n|R>|² is inclusive response strength, not a normalized probability/cross-section.
physical_event: Polarized carrier baselines are coherent eigenvectors of fixed-axis physical S inside the WHOLE selected lowest source-bright m0 degenerate block. U_field=exp(i sum_a kick_a E_a) acts ONLY on the field factor. Each baseline and its independently field-kicked state evolve with the SAME full H. Compare +spin and -spin induced physical current and spin changes, plus a same-initial-state vector-transfer-removed law. Original-law current may also be recorded as a labelled detector in that control, never renamed its own current.
